response.title: Negotiation-Policy Desk Note: Resolution 2254

items.text: The Council expressed support for a ceasefire linked to initial political-transition steps.
The Council requested convening negotiations with a historical target.
The Council expressed support for an inclusive political process and a historical election timetable.

How do the historical timetables and conditions impact the negotiation process?
